# Copilot Instructions

`AGENTS.md` is the canonical repository contract. Read it and the nearest scoped `AGENTS.md`
before proposing or editing code.

Preserve user work, never expose secrets, keep changes focused, use generated clients and
bindings correctly, verify tenant boundaries server-side, and add focused tests. Deployment,
remote migrations, secret changes, billing changes, and destructive Git require explicit human
approval.
